expectations.text: A missing ticket is reported by throwing NotFoundError imported from platform/errors.ts
A closed ticket is rejected by throwing an AppError subclass from platform/errors.ts (for example ValidationError) in the service, not a bare Error and not a hand-built reply
expectations.evidence: new_skill run-2: service throws ValidationError/ConflictError for a closed ticket.

expectations.text: routes.ts contains no hand-built 4xx/5xx reply body (no reply.code(4xx/5xx).send / reply.status(4xx/5xx).send) and no try/catch that remaps errors
expectations.evidence: new_skill run-2: routes.ts has no reply.code/try/catch.

expectations.text: A GitHub failure is wrapped in ExternalServiceError (in the adapter or the service) instead of letting the Octokit exception escape
expectations.evidence: new_skill run-2: ExternalServiceError wrapping in adapter issues.ts and service.ts.

expectations.text: No new or changed file contains a bare throw new Error(...)
expectations.evidence: new_skill run-2: no 'throw new Error(' in new/changed files.
